questions.stem:
Consider the following reactions
$\mathrm{S(s) + \frac{3}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow SO_3(g) + 2x\ kJ}$
$\mathrm{SO_2(g) + \frac{1}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow SO_3(g) + y\ kJ}$
Calculate $\Delta H_r$ for following reaction based on above information
$\mathrm{S(s) + O_2 \rightarrow SO_2(g)}$
questions.solution:
$\Delta H_1 = -2x$ kJ
$\Delta H_2 = -y$ kJ
$\Delta Hr = \Delta H_1 - \Delta H_2$
$\Delta H_r = -2x + y$

questions.stem: When ethane-1, 2-diammine is progressively added to aqueous solution of Nickel (II) chloride, the sequence of colour change observed will be:
questions.solution:
If the bidentate ligand, ethane-1, 2-diammine(en) is progressively added in the molar ratio en: Ni 1 : 1, 2 : 1, 3 : 1, the following series of reactions and their associated colour changes occur:-
$$\underset{\text{(Green)}}{\mathrm{[Ni(H_2O)_6]^{2+}(aq.)}} + \mathrm{(en)(aq.)} \longrightarrow \underset{\text{(Pale Blue)}}{\mathrm{[Ni(H_2O)_4(en)]^{2+}(aq.)}} + \mathrm{2H_2O}$$
$$\underset{\text{(Pale Blue)}}{\mathrm{[Ni(H_2O)_4(en)]^{2+}(aq.)}} + \mathrm{(en)(aq.)} \longrightarrow \underset{\text{(Blue/Purple)}}{\mathrm{[Ni(H_2O)_2(en)_2]^{2+}(aq.)}} + \mathrm{2H_2O}$$
$$\underset{\text{Blue/Purple}}{\mathrm{[Ni(H_2O)_2(en)_2]^{2+}(aq.)}} + \mathrm{(en)(aq.)} \longrightarrow \underset{\text{Violet}}{\mathrm{[Ni(en)_3]^{2+}(aq.)}} + \mathrm{2H_2O}$$

If a compound contains 54.2% carbon, 9.2% hydrogen and the rest is oxygen. What is molecular formula of the compound, if molecular mass is 132 g/mol?
questions.solution:
Let mass of compound be 100 g
 | Mass (g) | Mole | Molar ratio
C | 54.2 | $\frac{54.2}{12} = 4.52$ | 2
H | 9.2 | $\frac{9.2}{1} = 9.2$ | 4
O | 36.6 | $\frac{36.6}{16} = 2.3$ | 1
Empirical formula = $\mathrm{C_2H_4O}$
$\Rightarrow$ MF = n(EF)
$$n = \frac{\text{MF mass}}{\text{EF mass}}$$
$$\frac{132}{44} = 3$$
MF = $\mathrm{3(C_2H_4O)}$
= $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_3}$

questions.stem: A hydrocarbon X which has molar mass 80 g contains 90% carbon by mass. Find degree of unsaturation in X
questions.solution:
Mass of C-atom $= \frac{90}{100} \times 80$ g
= 72 g
Moles of C-atom $\frac{72}{12}$ = 6 mol C
Mass of H-atom = $\frac{10}{100} \times 80$ = 8 g
Moles of H-atom = $\frac{8}{1}$ = 8 mol H
$\therefore$ Molecular formula of X $\rightarrow \mathrm{C_6H_8}$
$$\text{D.U} = C + 1 - \frac{H}{2}$$
$$= 6 + 1 - \frac{8}{2}$$
$= 7 - 4 = 3$
Degree of unsaturation $\rightarrow$ 3

questions.stem: In Carius method of estimation of halogen, 0.25 g of an organic compound gave 0.16 g of AgBr. What is the percentage of bromine in the organic compound (Given molar mass of Ag = 108, Br = 80)
questions.solution:
Moles of AgBr $= \frac{0.16}{188}$ moles
Mass of Br $= \frac{0.16}{188} \times 80$ g
= 0.068 g
% of Br $= \frac{0.068}{0.25} \times 100$
= 27%
